title.narrative: Enhancing Community Resilience and Local Governance Project Phase II

description.narrative: 2. The AF aims to scale up the development effectiveness of the ECRP-II. The project is in an advanced stage of implementation and is expected to fully achieve its development objective. AF changes include: (i) adding activities to expand the scope of the operation in existing target areas; (ii) introducing a new subcomponent under Component 1: Infrastructure and Services for Community Resilience, to scale successful investments in urban infrastructure and services, targeting selected urban centers; (iii) updating the Results Framework (RF) to capture the expanded activities including project results related to more and better-paid jobs (MBJ); and (iv) extending the project closing date by two years to ensure successful completion of all ongoing and planned activities.

To improve access to services, strengthen flood resilience, and enhance institutional capacity for local service delivery and integrated disaster risk management at the national and sub-national levels.

condition.narrative: Schedule 2 Section I of the Financing Agreement: The Recipient shall no later than sixty (60) days from the Effective Dateestablish and thereafter maintain at all times during the implementation of the Project, a grievance redress mechanism, under termsand structure satisfactory to the Association.

Schedule 2 Section I.A.2 of the Financing Agreement: No later than ninety (90) days after the Effective Date, the Recipient shallestablish and thereafter maintain during the implementation of the Project, a Project Management Unit (PMU) within the MoFP and inpartnership with the LGB, with the composition, functions, staffing and resources satisfactory to the Association.

Schedule 2 Section I.A.3 (a) of the Financing Agreement: By no later than ninety (90) days after the Effective Date, the Recipientshall establish and thereafter maintain during the implementation of the Project a National Steering Committee (NSC), with thecomposition, functions, staffing and resources satisfactory to the Association, and responsible for providing oversight and policyguidance to the Project.

Schedule 2 Section I.A.3 (b) of the Financing Agreement: By no later than ninety (90) days after the Effective Date, the Recipientshall establish and thereafter maintain during the implementation of the Project a National Technical Working Group (NTWG), withthecomposition, functions, staffing and resources satisfactory to the Association, and responsible for discussing technicalimplementation-related issues of the Project at the national level.

Schedule 2 Section I.B of the Financing Agreement: The Recipient, through the MoFP, shall enter into, by no later than sixty (60)days after the Effective Date, and thereafter maintain throughout the period of Project implementation, an output agreement withIOM, under terms and conditions approved by the Association.

Schedule 2 Section I.C.(a) of the Financing Agreement: By no later than sixty (60) days after the Effective Date, prepare, inaccordance with terms of reference acceptable to the Association, a manual, which contains Project arrangements and procedures for:(i) institutional coordination and day-to-day implementation of the Project; (ii) monitoring, evaluation, reporting andcommunication; (iii) criteria, procedures and responsibilities for Sub-project selection; (iv) allocation of functions to, andresponsibilities of, IOM; (v) administration, procurement, financial management and accounting; (vi) mechanisms for accommodatingchanges in project implementation due to COVID-19; and (vii) such other administrative, technical and organizational arrangementsand procedures as shall be required for purposes of implementation of the Project.

Schedule 2 Section I.E of the Financing Agreement: Within one hundred eighty (180) days from the Effective Date, the Recipientshall hire, and thereafter maintain at all times during implementation of the Project, a Third-Party Monitoring Agent in accordancewith terms of reference satisfactory to the Association, to monitor and review performance of the Project.

Schedule 2 Section II.2 of the Financing Agreement: The Recipient shall ensure that each Third-Party Monitoring Report from theThird-Party Monitoring Agent, prepared in accordance with terms of reference acceptable to the Association is furnished to theAssociation within forty-five (45) days of the end of the period covered by said report.

Schedule 2. Section I. D1. The Recipient shall, by no later than sixty (60) days after the Effective Date, update in accordancewith terms of reference acceptable to the Association, the manual, which contains Project arrangements and procedures for: (i)institutional coordination and day-to-day implementation of the Project; (ii) monitoring, evaluation, reporting and communicationincluding for activities under Part 3 of the Project; (iii) criteria, procedures and responsibilities for Sub-project selectionunder Part 1 and 3 of the Project; (iv) allocation of functions to, and responsibilities of, IOM; (v) allocation of functions to,and responsibilities of the Selected NGOs under Part 3 of the Project (vi) administration, procurement, financial management andaccounting; and (viii) such other administrative, technical and organizational arrangements and procedures as shall be required forpurposes of implementation of the Project (“Project Implementation Manual” or “PIM”).

Schedule 2. Section I. F. By no later than ninety (90) days after the Effective Date, the Recipient shall recruit and maintain atall times during implementation of the Project, a Third-Party Monitoring Agent in accordance with terms of reference satisfactoryto the Association, to monitor and review performance of the Project, including the activities carried out by IOM, and the selectedNGOs under Part 3 of the Project.
